zipCodeComparison.neighborhoodsIncluded: Union Blvd Commercial & Residential Corridor, Minnisink & Lincoln Heights
keyFindings: Certified composite property tax rate is 2.934%, with an equalization ratio of 51.5%.
Public education represents 48.2% of property taxes, while municipal operations account for 34.6%.
Average residential assessment is $290,975, producing an average annual tax bill of $8,537.21.

neighborhoods.name: Union Blvd Commercial & Residential Corridor
neighborhoods.character: Bustling municipal and retail corridor with tree-lined residential side streets and suburban cape cods
neighborhoods.description: Civic center surrounding municipal hall, library, and local restaurants convenient to Route 46 and I-80.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Major office parks and corporate retail along Route 46 and Riverview Drive keep municipal tax rates low (2.934% certified).

neighborhoods.name: Minnisink & Lincoln Heights
neighborhoods.character: Elevated residential section with scenic topography, custom ranches, split-levels, and quiet cul-de-sacs
neighborhoods.description: Quiet suburban residential neighborhood overlooking the valley, convenient to Washington Park School and ballfields.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Solid middle-class residential tax roll with stable property appreciation.

equityAnalysis.summary: Totowa Borough maintains a certified residential tax roll across its neighborhoods.

keyTakeaways.title: Property Tax Burden & Household Income
keyTakeaways.detail: In Totowa Borough, homeowners pay an average of $8,537.21 annually in property taxes, consuming approximately 7.44% of median household income.

keyTakeaways.title: Equalization Ratio & Revaluation Balance
keyTakeaways.detail: With an equalization ratio of 51.5%, assessed values average ~51.5% of current true market values, establishing the basis for certified county tax equalization.

keyTakeaways.title: School District vs Municipal Levy Split
keyTakeaways.detail: Local education represents 48.2% of the total tax bill, municipal government absorbs 34.6%, and Passaic County claims 17.2%.
